findings.title: After cutover, npm publishes EQL V but the SQL/docs/image chain does not, and a re-run cannot re-drive it
findings.label: match
findings.note: Identifies that eql_published is set by a step after changeset publish, so a failed/re-run publish leaves npm V without the SQL/docs/image artefacts.

findings.title: SQL attached to the GitHub release and baked into the image is rebuilt, not the bytes npm and the crate shipped
findings.label: valid
findings.note: _build-eql-sql.yml regenerates SQL with mise run --force build under rust=latest instead of attaching the committed verified bytes, so release/image SQL can diverge from npm under the same stamp.

findings.title: release-plz publishes the crate on a push the release gate refused
findings.label: valid
findings.note: release-plz.yml's release job is gated only on eql-armed on its own push trigger, so the crate can publish when release.yml's gate or npm publish fails; this is the reverse direction of KD-2 and not its mechanism.

findings.title: Production npm half of the EQL switch is held by a different reader than the other four artefacts
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Production npm publish of @cipherstash/eql is gated by gate rather than eql-armed and AGENTS.md admits no test ties them, an untested invariant introduced here.

findings.title: Live JS/FFI releases now depend on the new `classify` job
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same as F-01: release/publish-ffi now depend on classify's production output, so a classify fault skips live JS/FFI releases.
